remarks:
This secluded cabin on 3 acres borders Gas Springs State Forest in Canaseraga NY, Allegany County.

This well-built one-bedroom cabin with loft is perfectly situated on a secluded parcel that directly borders Gas Springs State Forest.  A deeded easement from Gas Springs Road leads to this private cabin surrounded by a mix of hardwoods and softwoods that create excellent wildlife habitat and privacy.

The cabin has an open-concept layout with a spacious bedroom and a half-bath on the main level, along with a loft that provides additional sleeping space for children or guests.  A newer mini-split heating and cooling system ensures comfort in all seasons, and a fire-view wood stove adds additional warmth during hunting season.

Step outside to a large open deck and enjoy the unique outdoor amenities including an enclosed shower with propane on-demand hot water, a rainwater collection system with storage, and an on-site outhouse.  The yard features a designated fire pit area offering a comfortable space to relax and enjoy the outdoors.  Surface rights convey.

This property offers an outstanding opportunity for sportsmen with brushy areas and thick cover that attract whitetail deer.  This cabin is a true secluded escape near state land.
